verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents ships a hosted MCP server explicitly designed so assistants like Claude can 'create, configure, and manage the agents in your workspace through natural language, with nothing to install or run locally,' and a runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. This is a direct, first-party natural-language control surface, not just a client-side integration. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of a full natural-language agent-management session (only endpoint liveness was probed, not an actual successful NL task).
